R2 — `executeCommitPost` sets `results.retro` only when `readRetroResultIfExists` returns a value, and `readRetroResultIfExists` returns null when `retro.json` is missing, so no retro data is generated; no new RetroCommand/RunRetroCommand calls were introduced.

R3 — run-finalize now reads existing `retro.json` into `results.retro` (status/summary/requirements) before report generation, and the added finalize-local test asserts `report.json` contains matching `data.retro` fields including requirements.

R4 — The finalize path now injects `retro.json` into `results.retro` via `executeCommitPost`, and the new spec test explicitly validates report text contains the Retro aggregate line and not the `'-'`-only placeholder, matching the requirement.
